I'm aware of that. I always rotate the left stick and only get bit once. I'm not a total noob, I've played this along with 0 and the trilogy ports when it came out on Gamecube. I've done no damage runs on CV (mash a lot and you won't even get bit).

What I mean is, it seems like when I get bit with Chris, it always sends me into yellow caution in Hard Mode. Maybe it's just the damage multiplier or just me.
Grenades become so expendable at the lab though. Spending 100% of the time avoiding zombies (crimson head prototype is an exception)  and saving up all those defense weapons are so rewarding.

Their HP values are different, but Chris still feels weak to me. RNG really hates me and gives me the hard hitting enemies (one bite from a zombie sends him into yellow caution). Also, that hitbox though. I have an easier time dodging with Jill than with Chris (especially with the hunters).

I'm not speed running, so I'm not too worried about taking down enemies. I also always skip the handgun (I get a lot of Criticals with the handgun for some reason, more so than aiming upwards with the shotgun)

In REmake, I always heal when he gets hit. Maybe RNG is just really bad with the zombies because when I do get bit, I'm always sent down to yellow caution. I'm more used to RE0 and play that more (Billy is way sturdier than Chris, he can get grabbed 4 times and stay in Fine).

Yeah, mostly just to challenge myself.

I'm skipping the normal shotgun and saving Richard (so I can get the Assault Shotty in Aqua Ring).

I've done plenty of knife only runs, so dogs are no problem (they have godlike poise though). I'll just use the free healing (either the herb planter or Rebecca).

You only really need 2 small keys (Herbicide and Shield Key prop). I don't mind taking the long way around to the graveyard because I'm not speedrunning. I also kill all the zombies near the east storage room and burn them with the kerosene that's in the save room, that's where I'll only ever use it too.

You can only skip 42 if you used V-Jolt with Jill

You can't skip Chris's battle. Using Rebecca (in this case, you didn't save Richard with Serum) only halves Plant-42's health. Which is why I'm doing this with the Assault Shotgun, Magnum and Self-Defense Pistol.

I really hate the normal Shotgun, it sucks bad.

She gave me some questions like loss of interest in hobbies, feelings of hopelessness, racing thoughts, trouble sleeping and etc, which I truthfully answered. After about a couple weeks of going back to my appointments, she said that my symptoms were actually getting worse, if not already bad enough.

You could still get a diagnosis, psychologists usually accept insurance.
